stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2023 entering class). The newest Common Data Set Ashland posts that was found is 2022-2023 (ashland.edu/sites/default/files/2024-08/CDS_2022-2023.pdf), which is older than the IPEDS figures and was not used. College Navigator also shows fall 2024: 3,814 applicants, 76% admitted (exact admit count not given), SAT EBRW 505/560/610 and Math 530/560/598 for 32 submitters (7%), ACT composite 20/22/25 for 225 submitters (48%). SAT percentiles are not listed because only 9 enrolled students (2%) submitted SAT in fall 2023; ACT percentiles rest on 278 students (54%). International applicant and admit counts, GPA distribution and SAT total are not available from IPEDS; Ashland reported 230 international students from over 35 countries in spring 2025 (all levels).

cds_test_policy.notes: Ashland's undergraduate admissions page: sending ACT, CLT or SAT scores is optional for all majors except Nursing.
